findings: Inserting or changing a number did not raise late numerical-pole intensity on average. The pole is not tracking 'there is a digit in the prompt'.
Dropping a content noun shifted late intensity +0.0021 (up on 62%, down on 37%).
Swapping a noun shifted late intensity +0.0040 (up on 70%, down on 28%). A non-number edit moving the score means the probe is leaky.
Originals that already contain a number vs those that do not: late-band gap -0.0041 (with=0.0196, without=0.02367).
Compile causal_logic occupancy vs late intensity correlation r=0.000 (near zero means the atlas density and the number pole are not the same thing).
